text: Which boutique law firms in Brisbane Southside (Mount Gravatt & Sunnybank) offer free initial consultations, fixed-fee wills, or deferred-fee options for family law and wills and estates?

sections.text:
The clearest Southside matches are:

| Firm | Area | Relevant offer |
|---|---|---|
| **Life Law Solutions** | Mount Gravatt East | Advertises a **free 30-minute family-law consultation**. It also offers fixed-fee transparency for family-law work and fixed-fee estate-planning packages, with wills packages starting at **$1,690 for individuals** and **$2,550 for couples**.[1][4][5] |
| **Campbells Legal** | Upper Mount Gravatt | Offers a **free initial discussion** to assess whether a solicitor is needed. Straightforward wills can generally be quoted at a **fixed fee upfront**.[6] |
| **Times Lawyers** | Sunnybank | Provides an initial consultation to understand the matter before quoting; it handles **family law and wills and estates**. The available information does not confirm that the initial consultation is free, so this should be verified directly.[2][10] |
| **Wheldon & Associates** | Sunnybank | Handles **family law, succession planning and deceased-estate administration**. No free-consultation or fixed-fee offer was confirmed in the available information.[2][10] |
| **Ian W Bartels & Associates** | Mount Gravatt area | Offers **family law and wills and estates** and describes its services as affordable. No specific free-consultation, fixed-fee or deferred-fee offer was confirmed.[2][10] |
| **Peter G. Williams & Associates** | Brisbane Southside | Boutique firm offering **family law and wills and estate planning**. No specific pricing concession was confirmed.[2][10] |

For **deferred or payment-plan options**, the strongest confirmed match is **R&G Law Group**, which offers payment plans for eligible matters and a free 15-minute consultation for Queensland residents, but its listed Brisbane office is not specifically in Mount Gravatt or Sunnybank.[8] **Bespoke Legal Group** also offers payment plans, a free 20-minute family-law consultation, and fixed-fee estate-planning services, but its listed Brisbane office is in the CBD rather than the Southside.[9]

Before booking, ask each firm to confirm:

- Whether the free consultation applies to your specific family-law or estates issue.
- Whether the quoted will fee includes an enduring power of attorney, advance-health directive, witnessing and revisions.
- Whether family-law fees can be staged, deferred or paid by instalment.
- Whether court filing, barrister, valuation and other third-party costs are additional.
